narr: An active monsoon season continued to impact Southern California, with multiple days of thunderstorms reported across the mountains from August 22-26. The main hazards were heavy rain and minor debris flows, as well as gusty winds from thunderstorms.
ev: Heavy rain on I-8 near the Crestwood Road on-ramp. Multiple vehicles parked on the right hand side due to the torrential rain, hail, and poor visibility.
